description: Weather history (observed daily) — Observed daily weather history for any place from the nearest NOAA GHCN-Daily station (worldwide, records back decades): daily high/low, precipitation, snow, snow depth, average wind and peak gust, plus a period summary (avg high/low, extremes with dates, total and wettest-day precip, rain days, 90F days, freezing nights). place= or lat=&lon=; start=&end= (YYYY-MM-DD, up to 366 days), date= or month=YYYY-MM; units=standard|metric. Default: latest 30 days on record (data lags about a week). Public-domain NOAA NCEI data. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_history
